_comment: Only-Short Grid Bot config. The grid is 100% dynamic: no fixed price list. grid_step_pct defines the geometric spacing between levels (Level_N = base_price * (1 + grid_step_pct/100)^N); base_price (Range 0) is re-anchored to the live market price at startup and after every Take Profit reset, so it is never a config value either. Credentials: prefer BYBIT_API_KEY/BYBIT_API_SECRET env vars; exchange.api_key/api_secret below are the fallback the bot always falls back to.
_comment_symbol_timeframe: symbol accepts any CCXT/Bybit V5 perpetual, e.g. 'ETH/USDT:USDT' or 'BTC/USDC:USDC'. timeframe drives the grid-evaluation clock automatically: '5m' evaluates at XX:05:01/XX:10:01/... (fast testing), '1h' evaluates at HH:00:01 (production).
_comment_take_profit: Fixed take profit: closes the whole position at market the instant mark_price crosses net_breakeven_pct% BELOW the current Break-Even NETTO price (already fee/funding-adjusted). No trailing/retracement wait -- fires the moment the target is crossed. net_breakeven_pct is a real PRICE percentage, not a leveraged-margin percentage (at 100x leverage, 3% price = ~300% PnL on margin).
_comment_stress_test: High-frequency time-acceleration stress test mode. When enabled=true it REPLACES the normal timeframe/candle-close scheduler: all ranges evaluate at base_interval_sec (flat, no per-range table) UNLESS RSI tick mode is active, in which case grid orders fire every tick_mode_interval_sec instead. RSI tick mode is triggered by an RSI(rsi_period) reading on rsi_timeframe crossing UP through rsi_overbought_threshold (a fresh crossing from below -- staying overbought does not re-trigger it), and stays on until the position's Break-Even price catches up to the market's current grid band, at which point Range 0 re-anchors there and the base cadence resumes. unlimited_fib_level=true removes the risk.max_fib_level safety cap for this mode only. Set enabled=false to fall back to the normal production scheduler/cap untouched.
